runs.title: Initial skill radar: create, review, then optimize
runs.summary: Three source-pinned listings separate visual direction, UI review, and React or Next.js performance; no shared result test was performed.

runs.title: Two React skills, two different failure modes
runs.summary: Added source-pinned skills for React component architecture and meaningful view-transition motion; a Composition Patterns example concern remains third-party and unverified by this pool.

runs.title: A portable skill can still be the wrong project configuration
runs.summary: Kept five task lanes and added a documented adoption gate for target agent, scope, local edits, and upstream-update review; no installation or result test was performed.

runs.title: A visual skill needs a visual proof path
runs.summary: Added source-pinned OpenAI Frontend App Builder for concept-led new visual surfaces; its Image Gen and browser-comparison workflow is author guidance, not a pool result test.

runs.title: A screenshot audit needs a real flow
runs.summary: Added source-pinned OpenAI Product Design Audit for captured product-flow review; it needs a known journey and screenshot route, and does not establish full accessibility compliance from pixels.

runs.title: A browser skill can show the state. It cannot judge the design.
runs.summary: Added Vercel Agent Browser 0.38.1 for versioned browser-driven frontend state capture; it can supply inspection evidence but is not a design or accessibility verdict.

runs.title: Dogfood the flow. Do not ask it to invent the design system.
runs.summary: Added Vercel Agent Browser Dogfood 0.38.1 for source-pinned exploratory QA with replayable browser evidence; its published workflow is not a result test or a design-system substitute.

runs.title: QA needs the right browser surface.
runs.summary: Added a conditional QA lane for a named rendered frontend change or bug and made browser backend, viewport, session context, and visible state part of the evidence record.

runs.title: A design skill needs a complete state model.
runs.summary: Added source-pinned PracticalSwan Frontend Design 2.0 for substantial product work with an explicit state and verification protocol; its author guidance has not been installed or result-tested by this pool.

runs.title: Make the visual decision before you ask Codex to apply it.
runs.summary: Added source-pinned Wenkang Frontend Design for project-bound visual feedback before implementation; its local preview and Markdown export are author workflow, not a pool test of the live route.

runs.title: A detailed frontend workflow is not ready if its package metadata fails.
runs.summary: Held Snowe UI Skill outside the catalogue because GitHub currently displays a YAML frontmatter error in its SKILL.md. The pool did not install it or test host behavior.

runs.title: Choose a visual direction before you build.
runs.summary: Added OpenAI Product Design Ideate as a conditional mutable-source plugin skill for three image-based directions before prototype work; its availability and outcome remain untested by the pool.

runs.title: One direction for the real screen.
runs.summary: Added PaulRBerg Frontend Design as a conditional mutable-source listing for an existing or substantial screen that needs one project-bound direction and rendered inspection; its browser dependency, Codex loading, and outcome are untested by the pool.

runs.title: A game HUD is not a dashboard.
runs.summary: Added OpenAI Game UI Frontend for browser-game HUD, menu, and overlay work where playfield visibility and camera or menu input boundaries matter; its mutable source, Codex loading, and outcomes are untested by the pool.

runs.title: For a form, design the failure path too.
runs.summary: Added a conditional form-specific skill route with mutable-source and untested-outcome limits.

runs.title: Check the React composition example before you copy it.
runs.summary: Verified the pinned lifted-state example mismatch directly in source; the listing now warns readers without claiming a runtime failure.

runs.title: OpenDesign’s frontend-skill entry is not the full workflow.
runs.summary: Held an OpenDesign discovery entry outside the catalogue after tracing its removed upstream skill; no installation or result was tested.

runs.title: Already have a design system? Do not ask for a new palette.
runs.summary: Clarified a source-level task-fit boundary for Anthropic Frontend Design and fixed its pinned source link; no result test was performed.

runs.title: Test a web skill against no skill
runs.summary: Two external benchmarks found different average effects under different tasks and loading setups; neither ranks our sixteen listings or measures visual quality.

runs.title: A design-system skill is a build project, not a ready-made pick
runs.summary: Vercel Labs documents a pipeline for generating source-derived design-system skills. It is not a seventeenth ready-made listing; Codex use and outcome gains remain untested.

runs.title: A motion default needs an off switch
runs.summary: Silk Design makes motion and smooth scrolling defaults. We held it outside the catalogue pending stack, reduced-motion, mobile, and result checks.

runs.title: An update message does not verify your installed skill
runs.summary: Vercel Skills’ inspected global-update path does not check installed bytes. Added a post-update file check for locally adapted skills.

runs.title: For a dashboard, define the data task before adding a skill
runs.summary: Added a conditional dashboard route from pinned skill instructions and one audience request. No outcome comparison was run.

runs.title: A no-install trial still needs a complete skill prompt
runs.summary: Added a direct trial route and a version-specific prompt-delivery warning. No CLI execution or outcome comparison was run.

runs.title: The brief wins over design defaults

runs.title: Know the screen before you ask for three designs

runs.title: A web artifact is not your live website

runs.title: Need a new design, or proof the current one works?
